Commentary.Commentary: Right then, Bangladesh have done what they were expected to do coming into this series. Next up, they will go to New Zealand for the tri-series which involves Pakistan along with the host nation. United Arab Emirates, on the other hand, will now fly to Australia for the T20 World Cup. It shall be an exciting next month or so for both these teams and all cricket fans. Also, there is lot of other cricketing action that you can catch up in the meanwhile. Till then, it's goodbye and cheers from our side!

Nurul Hasan, the skipper of Bangladesh says that it is a good feeling to win the game and adds that the whole team played well. Mentions that winning is a habit and this win will help them in the World Cup. Signs off by thanking the United Arab Emirates team and their board for organising this series.
Mehidy Hasan is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH!

Chundangapoyil Rizwan, the skipper of United Arab Emirates says that the game didn’t go the way they wanted as they didn’t get a good start in the Powerplay and lost too many wickets. When asked about Bangladesh, he admits that they showed they are a quality side and if they play more games against quality teams, they we will definitely improve. Claims that they really wanted to build a partnership but the credits the Bangladesh bowlers for doing really well and hopes that their bowlers can learn from that as well. Mentions that they will be travelling to Australia in a couple of days and they will look to get some good warm-up before the World Cup. Ends by thanking the Bangladesh team for playing the series with them.
Presentation time...

Earlier in the game, Bangladesh batted quite positively for the most part of their innings but could not get the finish they would have hoped for. Mehidy Hasan was the top-scorer for them and there were also some handy cameos that took them to a good score of 169. For, United Arab Emirates their young spinners, Karthik Meiyappan and Aayan Khan were pretty good and they were also quite impressive with their death bowling. However, their batters found it tough against the quality of Bangladesh in the run-chase and it is Bangladesh who have whitewashed United Arab Emirates here.

Well, United Arab Emirates can learn a lot from this chase. The positives for them will be the way Rizwan and Hameed fought it out in the middle after losing four early wickets. The skipper, Rizwan got to his fifty while Hameed scored 42 as they notched up a 90-run stand. From hereon, it is important that they try to pace their chase a bit better and if they do that, they can surely cross the line in future.

Bangladesh were better with the bat in this game than they were in the last game and that gave their bowlers a bit more luxury coming into the second half. They were much clinical with the ball too this time around and were quite brilliant in the initial overs as they restricted United Arab Emirates to 29-4 at one stage. Both Taskin Ahmed and Ebadot Hossain bowled with lot of fire while Mosaddek Hossain got two in two to put United Arab Emirates in all sorts of trouble. However, they failed to find a breakthrough after that till the 19th over but they always kept the game in their grasp during that period too and ended up winning it comfortably in the end.

Bangladesh have clinched this series by a 2-0 margin and this one has been a more convincing performance by the Bangla Tigers. However, United Arab Emirates have once again shown some good fighting spirit and this series will surely help them in their journey Down Under. This series was also a perfect chance for both these sides to iron out their flaws ahead of the World Cup, and with the kind of cricket we have seen, it has surely been a productive series for both these sides.

Two runs to end the game and Bangladesh seal a comfortable win. Taskin Ahmed continues bowling full and outside off, Zawar Farid strokes this to the right of cover and the batters take two runs as the ball is collected in the deep. The visitors win by 32 runs and grab a series win.
This is full as well and outside off, Zawar Farid attempts another paddle shot but misses this time.
WIDE! Taskin Ahmed has got his radar off here! Attempts a slower delivery wide outside off but the ball is beyond the tram line and this is called wide once again.
WIDE! Taskin Ahmed goes way outside off on a fuller length, Chundangapoyil Rizwan leaves this alone and the umpire calls wide.
This is full and on the pads, Zawar Farid clips this down to fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Taskin Ahmed bowls this on a good length and outside off, Zawar Farid goes outside the off pole and scoops this towards third man for a boundary.
Nurul Hasan seems to have hurt his fingers now. Bangladesh will hope that it is not serious enough and for now it looks fine as he is ready to resume.

This is on a yorker length and just outside off, Chundangapoyil Rizwan gets his bat down and gets an inside edge to the left of the keeper who gets a glove on it as he dives. The ball is parried towards short fine leg for a single.

Taskin Ahmed bowls a short ball outside off, Zawar Farid charges down the wicket and pulls this towards mid-wicket for a quick single. The fielder takes aim at the stumps but misses and the batter would have been gone if that had hit.

FOUR! That brings up the half-century for the Chundangapoyil Rizwan and he has played really well in this game! Ebadot Hossain bowls this full and outside off, Chundangapoyil Rizwan knocks this over cover for another  boundary.
Fires this one full and angled into the stumps, Chundangapoyil Rizwan flicks this towards deep mid-wicket and they take a brace.
Bowls this full and outside off, Chundangapoyil Rizwan swings but does not connect.
Zawar Farid is the next batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! The partnership has finally been broken! Ebadot Hossain serves a low full toss outside the off pole, Basil Hameed goes hard at the ball but only manages to slice this towards the deep point fielder. Afif Hossain comes running in from the boundary and takes a fine catch low as he came in sliding. Basil Hameed departs after reaching his highest score in T20I's.
Commentary.Howout: c Afif Hossain b Ebadot Hossain

Commentary.Commentary: On a yorker length and outside off, Chundangapoyil Rizwan works this towards deep point and takes a single.
Ebadot Hossain serves this one really full and outside the off pole, Chundangapoyil Rizwan does not get his bat down in time and is beaten
A short delivery this time bowled in line with the stumps, Chundangapoyil Rizwan pulls this awkwardly and mistimes his shot to the off side for a single. He will retain strike.
Bowls this on a yorker length and aims for the toes, Basil Hameed moves this foot out of the way and knocks this ball to the left of the bowler for a quick single.
Bangs this in short and wide outside off, Basil Hameed looks to make room and slashes at it but is too far as the ball goes through to the keeper.
Taskin Ahmed serves a slower delivery wide outside off, Chundangapoyil Rizwan reaches for this and toe ends the ball towards long on for a single.
Bowls this on a good length and outside off, Chundangapoyil Rizwan goes for an expansive drive but is beaten all ends up.
Taskin Ahmed fires in a yorker full and outside the off pole, Chundangapoyil Rizwan is unable to dig this one out.

FOUR! This is some good batting from United Arab Emirates! Mohammad Saifuddin bowls this full and outside off, Basil Hameed steps across to the off side and paddles this over the third man fielder for a boundary. The ball lands just short of the ropes but the shot definitely deserved more.
Bowls a low full toss and serves this outside off, Chundangapoyil Rizwan taps this towards deep point and takes a run.
This is on a good length and outside the off pole, Chundangapoyil Rizwan heaves towards the leg side and the ball falls short of the mid-wicket fielder. they run well and take two.
Pulls his length back a fraction and in line with the stumps, Basil Hameed pulls this towards deep mid-wicket and takes a single.
Fires in a yorker just outside off stump, Chundangapoyil Rizwan gets low and digs this out towards cover-point for a run.
WIDE! Bowls a slower delivery full and well outside the off pole. This is beyond the tram line and called wide by the umpire.
Mohammad Saifuddin bowls this on a good length and outside off, Basil Hameed under edges this down into the pitch on the off side and Chundangapoyil Rizwan pushes for a single.
This is in line with the stumps on a fuller length, Chundangapoyil Rizwan clips this towards deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.

FOUR! This has been thumped! Nasum Ahmed continues to flight this on a fuller length and outside the off pole, Chundangapoyil Rizwan gets his front foot forwards and strokes this to deep cover for a boundary.
Flights this one outside off on a fuller length, Basil Hameed flicks this down the long on for a run.
This is full as well and in line with the stumps, Basil Hameed pushes this to the right of the bowler.
This is full and angled into the pads, Chundangapoyil Rizwan shimmies down the wicket and knocks the ball to long off for a single.
SIX! Chundangapoyil Rizwan is on the charge here! Nasum Ahmed floats this full and outside off, Chundangapoyil Rizwan gets on one knee and slog sweeps this over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Back of a length and around off. Rizwan steers it towards third man for a single. 80 needed now from 30 balls!
Back of a length, on middle. Basil Hameed clips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A fullish delivery, around off. Rizwan clears his front leg and slices it to deep point for a single.

SIX! Chundangapoyil Rizwan clears the fence and this is much-needed for United Arab Emirates! Ebadot Hossain bangs it short and on middle. Rizwan pulls it and does so aerially over the square leg fence for a maximum.
Back of a length and on middle. Basil Hameed pulls it to deep backward square leg for a single.
Serves it full and outside off. Basil Hameed tries to drive it but misses.
A very full delivery on middle. Basil Hameed knocks it down to long on for a single.
WIDE! Full and down the leg side. Basil Hameed tries to sweep it but misses.
Tad shorter and on middle. Rizwan pulls it to deep backward square leg for a single.

Oh, good effort in the field but the ball falls short of the diving fielder! This is fuller on middle. Basil Hameed sweeps and gets a top edge on this one. The ball goes aerially towards deep backward square leg and the fielder there runs to his right and forward, dives to catch it. However, he fails and a single is taken.
This is fuller and outside off. Rizwan drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Tad shorter and on off. Basil Hameed makes room and cuts it to point. The batters run across for a quick single.
A flatter delivery on middle. Basil Hameed clips it towards the leg side.
Single to end the over and now 96 needed from 42 balls! On a length, on off. Basil Hameed defends it towards the off side for a single.
FOUR! This is a good confident shot from Basil Hameed! Mohammad Saifuddin overpitches it outisde off. Basil Hameed leans forward and creams it through covers for a boundary.
Lands it on a length and it is close to off again. Rizwan guides it to third man for a single.
On a length and around off. Basil Hameed punches it to deep point for a single.
FOUR! Good shot! A slower short ball on off. Basil Hameed pulls it in the gap towards the deep square leg region for a boundary.
NO BALL! Mohammad Saifuddin oversteps this time and bowls it on a good length and outside off. Basil Hameed tries to push it away but misses. A Free Hit coming up...
A fullish delivery, outside off. Basil Hameed tries to drive it but gets beaten.
A fullish delivery on off. Basil Hameed knocks it down to long off for a single.
Oh, well bowled! Rizwan makes room and Hasan fires this on middle at a yorker length. Luckily, Rizwan manages to get his bat down in time and guides it to short third man. Single taken.
Angles it on the pads. Basil Hameed clips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A quicker delivery that is tad shorter and on off. Basil Hameed tries to cut it but gets the outsid edge towards short third man.
Another full delivery on middle that is pushed down to long on for a single.
Serves it full and on middle. Basil Hameed clips it right of long on for a single.
A fullish delivery, outside off. Rizwan tries to drive it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Bowls this back of a length and outside off, Basil Hameed guides this towards third man and takes a single.
WIDE! Ebadot Hossain bowls another bouncer but drifts way down the leg side. Basil Hameed shapes up to pull it but then lets it go. Wided!
Bangs it short and on middle. Basil Hameed ducks under it.
Bowls a yorker-length delivery, it is outside off and Basil Hameed fails to dig it out.
Back of a length and on middle. Rizwan pulls it to deep backward square leg for a single.

Back of a length and around off. Rizwan guides it to left of the third man fielder and comes back for the second run. The fielder throws it to the keeper and he fires a direct hit at the batter's end but Rizwan was well inside the crease.

Drinks break. This is looking quite tough for United Arab Emirates now. They have not been able to get going at all in this chase and have lost their key batters at regular intervals which now has made the task of chasing down this total a daunting one. Bangladesh bowlers have bowled pretty well, the pacers bowled with lot of fire and their spinners like always have made life further difficult for the batters. Will see some spirited fightback from United Arab Emirates? We shall find out as Ebadot Hossain is back into the attack.
Goes outside the off pole this time on a fuller length, Chundangapoyil Rizwan guides this to the right of short third man and takes a single to keep strike.
Onto the pads once again on a shorter length, Basil Hameed goes back in the crease and tucks this towards deep square leg for another run.
Straying onto the pads once again on a fuller length, Chundangapoyil Rizwan clips this towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Floats this one full and on leg, Basil Hameed knocks this to long on for one more.

Poor fielding from Bangladesh! Mehidy Hasan bowls this a fraction short and outside off, Basil Hameed taps this towards short third man and takes off for a run. The fielder misfields but does not concede a run, decides to throw the ball and they do get the second from an overthrow.
Flighted delivery bowled in line with the stumps, Chundangapoyil Rizwan flicks this towards long on as the singles continue.
Six singles in the over! This is angled into the pads on a fuller length, Chundangapoyil Rizwan punches this to long on for one.
Bowls it quicker and on middle. Basil Hameed clips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Continues bowling full but this is outside off, Chundangapoyil Rizwan strokes this to long off for another single.
Goes back to bowling full and straight, Basil Hameed works this to long on for another run.
This is fraction short and outside off, Chundangapoyil Rizwan taps this towards short third man for one.
Mosaddek Hossain flights this full and just outside off, Basil Hameed uses his wrists and works this to long on for a single.
This is even fuller and in line with the stumps, Basil Hameed clips this to deep mid-wicket and will take one to keep strike.
Goes full this time and straight, Chundangapoyil Rizwan clips this towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Continues bowling short and outside off, Basil Hameed pulls this to long on for a single.

FOUR! Sabbir Rahman has been way too short in this over and gets the treatment this time! This is in line with the stumps and Basil Hameed rocks back in the crease and pulls the ball towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
This is short as well and outside the off pole, Chundangapoyil Rizwan slaps this to deep cover and takes another run.
Sabbir Rahman begins with a short delivery outside off, Basil Hameed cuts this to the right of short third man and takes one.
Sabbir Rahman is into the attack now.
Fires this one full and into the pads, Basil Hameed clips this to deep mid-wicket and gets off the mark with a single. 2 runs and 2 wickets in Mosaddek Hossain's first over.
Basil Hameed prevents the Hat-trick! Mosaddek Hossain bowls this full and attacks the stumps, Basil Hameed is watchful as he defends this towards the off side.
Basil Hameed walks in next.

OUT! BOWLED! Two in two for Mosaddek Hossain and he will be on a hat-trick now! This is clever bowling from Mosaddek Hossain, he sees Vriitya Aravind backing away and fires this on middle. It is bit shorter and Vriitya Aravind tries to cut it. He misses it completely and the ball knocks over the middle pole. Vriitya Aravind looks very disappointed and so will be the whole United Arab Emirates team managament, they are in some serious trouble now.
Chundangapoyil Rizwan is the next batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! United Arab Emirates are crumbling here as they lose their third wicket! Mosaddek Hossain floats this one full and outside the off pole, Aryan Lakra charges down the wicket and looks to lift this over long off. Slices this towards the deep point region where Nasum Ahmed comes running in from the deep and takes an easy catch. Bangladesh are right on top here and will be looking to press forward their advantage.
Commentary.Howout: c Nasum Ahmed b Mosaddek Hossain

Commentary.Commentary: Floats this one full and in line with the stumps, Aryan Lakra shimmies down the wicket and blocks this back towards the bowler.
Mosaddek Hossain bowls this a fraction short and outside off, Vriitya Aravind cuts this to deep point and takes a run.
Mosaddek Hossain is into the attack now.

Keeps attacking the outside off stump line on a good length, Vriitya Aravind guides this to third man for a single. United Arab Emirates are 28 for 2 after the Powerplay and they have an uphill task from here.
Continues bowling on a good length and outside the off stump, Vriitya Aravind taps this towards point.
This is on a good length and outside the off pole. Gets good shape away and Vriitya Aravind is happy to leave this one alone.
Vriitya Aravind walks out at number 4!

OUT! PLUMB! Taskin Ahmed strikes and his pace has been too much for the United Arab Emirates batters to handle! Taskin Ahmed serves this full and angles this into the stumps, Muhammad Waseem looks to clip this leg side but does not manage to keep his head still and plays all over this delivery. The ball raps against the pads and the bowler goes up in an appeal. The umpire raises his finger and this looks pretty straightforward. Both the openers are now back in the shed.
This is on a good length as well and on the pads, Aryan Lakra clips this to the square leg region for a single.
Taskin Ahmed bowls this on a good length and pitches this outside leg, Aryan Lakra looks to tuck this away but misses as the ball goes through to the keeper.
SIX! This is what Muhammad Waseem can do! Smashes another one over the fence! This is on middle. Muhammad Waseem slog-sweeps it this time over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
SIX! Muhammad Waseem finally breaks the shackles! This is tossed up, on off. Muhammad Waseem steps out a bit, gets to the pitch of the ball and tonks it over long off for a maximum.
Bowls it short and on middle. Aryan Lakra pulls it to deep square leg for a single. Good work by the fielder in the deep.
A flatter delivery on middle. Muhammad Waseem clips it to square leg and takes a quick single.
Fires it on the pads. Aryan Lakra clips it to short fine leg. The fielder there charges towards the ball but misfields and a single is taken.
A flatter delivery on off. Aryan Lakra cuts it to the point fielder.

Another good over for Bangladesh, just 2 from this one! Bowls a yorker, outside off. Muhammad Waseem tries to dig it out but misses. Well, United Arab Emirates need to get going here, only two overs are left in the Powerplay now.
Drags his length back a bit, on off. Muhammad Waseem dabs it towards the point fielder.
Serves it on a length and outside off. Muhammad Waseem tries to push it away but gets the inside edge off the bounce to the keeper.
Bangs it short and angles it into middle and leg. Muhammad Waseem ducks under it.
Bowls it on a good length, on off. Lakra tries to defend it but gets the inside edge and the ball rolls towards the leg side for a single.
On a length and around off. Muhammad Waseem guides it to third man for a single.
Tossed up, on off. Aryan Lakra drives it to the mid off fielder. Brilliant over, just one from it and a big wicket of Chirag Suri.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Nasum Ahmed draws first blood and Chirag Suri has to depart! He floats this one full and outside the off pole, Chirag Suri looks to heave this across the line towards the leg side but is early into the shot. Gets a top edge that goes high to the left of the bowler towards the cover region. He runs towards it asking the fielders to stay away and takes a comfortable catch. The introduction of spin has yielded a wicket straightaway and United Arab Emirates have been pegged back here. Aryan Lakra makes his way out to the crease at number 3.
Another flatter and quicker delivery on middle. Suri nudges it to the leg side.
Pushed quicker on middle. Suri clips it to mid-wicket.
Tad shorter and on middle Muhammad Waseem makes room and tries to cut it. However, the ball goes off the inside edge of his blade past stumps towards short fine leg for a single.
A flatter delivery on off. Muhammad Waseem blocks it out.

FOUR! Ohh...he finds the edge this time but the ball right of the diving slip fielder for a boundary. A fullish delivery, outside off. There is that shape away from the batter again and Suri gets an outsid edge as he tries to drive it and the ball goes away from the slip fielder towards the third man fence.
Bowls it full and wider outside off. Suri tries to chase it but gets beaten again as the ball seams away.
Ohh..this has been a very good over so far! He bowls it on a good length and around off. The ball seams away a bit after pitching and Suri gets beaten on the outside edge as he tries to defend it.
Serves it on a good length again, around off. Suri makes a good leave this time.
On a good length and outside off. Suri leaves it alone. Good channel from Taskin Ahmed!

Ohh..away shape for Taskin Ahmed! On a good length and outside off. The ball moves away late and Muhammad Waseem who makes a late decision to leave it, gets some bat to it and the ball runs away to third man for a single.
Good start from Mohammad Saifuddin, just 3 from the first over! Serves it on a length and it is outside off. Suri goes pushing for it but gets beaten.
Serves it on a length and drifts on the pads. Muhammad Waseem clips it to left of short fine leg for a single.
Bangs it short on middle. Muhammad Waseem ducks under it. Good delivery!
Pitches it up, on off. Muhammad Waseem drills it to mid on.
On the shorter side again, on middle. Suri nudges it towards the leg side and gets off the mark as well.
Starts off with a back-of-a-length delivery on off. Muhammad Waseem turns it towards mid-wicket and takes a single. United Arab Emirates are underway!
